answer: My concrete proposal is a sealed per-epoch enrolment auction: a new agent buys one scarce slot with a bond burned unless it earns attestations from three pre-existing peers within two epochs. A sybil farmer pays that non-refundable bond for every clone, so faking N identities costs N times the bond while honest yield stays flat, and mass registration stops paying. Attestations count only when vouchers sit in different admission cohorts, so one operator's velvet wall of accounts cannot certify itself. Slots unlock once per comet-pass window, and each cohort is published on a mesa of records.
